steps.title: Processed yet?
steps.body: New documents appear when processingHistory is later than bulkUploadHistory.

steps.title: Users really indexed?
steps.body: UPLOAD COMPLETED means only that the API accepted the upload.

steps.title: Flags right?
steps.body: Incorrect pagination flags can make a partial upload look complete.

steps.title: Properties valid?
steps.body: Validation stops at the first invalid custom property. Fix and retry iteratively.

steps.title: Reprocess
steps.body: /processalldocuments re-indexes without a new upload; for user or group problems, use /processallmemberships.

steps.title: Escalate well
steps.body: Include the issue and error, the endpoint and request body, the connector name, and a timestamp with time zone.
